description: Responsive three-region editor frame: Header/Toolbar on top, Left and Right panels around the Canvas, an optional StatusBar, and mobile actions. Desktop and tablet render docked, resizable columns that collapse to a rail (on tablet at most one panel is expanded, never a modal); mobile renders the canvas with the panels in an inline non-modal bottom sheet (Sheet) or as a Left | Canvas | Right tablist (Tabs) above the mobile action bar. Thresholds are per instance (Breakpoints).

parameters.name: Header
parameters.description: Content of the top header region (a title, breadcrumbs, the primary save action).

parameters.name: Toolbar
parameters.description: Content of the toolbar region below the header. Receives the shell's cascaded TmLayoutContext, so content can adapt. Not rendered on a mobile layout when MobileActions is set.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The left panel (a toolbox, a block list). A docked column on desktop, a side sheet on tablet, part of the mobile panels sheet.

parameters.name: Canvas
parameters.description: The central canvas. Rendered at every layout.

parameters.name: Right
parameters.description: The right panel (an inspector, properties). A docked column on desktop, a side sheet on tablet, part of the mobile panels sheet.

parameters.name: StatusBar
parameters.description: Optional status bar content, rendered below the main region (inside it, above the panels sheet, on mobile).

parameters.name: MobileActions
parameters.description: The shell's mobile actions, rendered through TmMobileActionBar at the bottom of a mobile layout. When set the Toolbar slot is not rendered on mobile (the actions replace it).

parameters.name: LeftOpen
parameters.description: Whether the left panel is open. Two-way with LeftOpenChanged.

parameters.name: LeftOpenChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the left panel should open or close (every close path funnels through here).

parameters.name: RightOpen
parameters.description: Whether the right panel is open. Two-way with RightOpenChanged.

parameters.name: RightOpenChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the right panel should open or close.

parameters.name: CollapsedPanels
parameters.description: Panels rendered collapsed to a slim rail. Two-way with CollapsedPanelsChanged.

parameters.name: CollapsedPanelsChanged
parameters.description: Raised when a panel is collapsed to, or expanded from, its rail.

parameters.name: MobilePanelPresentation
parameters.description: How the open panels present on a mobile layout: Sheet (canvas + bottom sheet, with a Left/Right tab strip when both panels are open) or Tabs (a full-region Left | Canvas | Right tablist, no sheet).

parameters.name: LeftTitle
parameters.description: The left panel title — the mobile tab label and the tablet side-sheet title.

parameters.name: RightTitle
parameters.description: The right panel title — the mobile tab label and the tablet side-sheet title.

parameters.name: LeftWidth
parameters.description: Width of the left panel, a CSS pixel length. Two-way with LeftWidthChanged. A width the host sets after a user resize wins over a stored one.

parameters.name: LeftWidthChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new "NNNpx" width when the user resizes the left panel (pointer drag or keyboard on its separator).

parameters.name: RightWidth
parameters.description: Width of the right panel, a CSS pixel length. Two-way with RightWidthChanged.

parameters.name: RightWidthChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new "NNNpx" width when the user resizes the right panel.

parameters.name: MinLeftWidth
parameters.description: Smallest width in CSS pixels the left panel can be resized to.

parameters.name: MaxLeftWidth
parameters.description: Largest width in CSS pixels the left panel can be resized to.

parameters.name: MinRightWidth
parameters.description: Smallest width in CSS pixels the right panel can be resized to.

parameters.name: MaxRightWidth
parameters.description: Largest width in CSS pixels the right panel can be resized to.

parameters.name: MinCanvasWidth
parameters.description: The canvas width in CSS pixels a resize never takes away: a panel stops growing where the canvas would drop below it.

parameters.name: Breakpoints
parameters.description: Per-instance layout thresholds. Null uses TmLayoutBreakpoints.Default (mobile below 640, desktop from 1024). An e-mail editor that wants desktop from 1200 and mobile below 768 passes new TmLayoutBreakpoints(768, 1200).

parameters.name: ActiveMobilePanel
parameters.description: The panel a mobile layout shows: the selected sheet tab (Left or Right) or, in the Tabs presentation, the selected tab (None is the canvas). Two-way with ActiveMobilePanelChanged, so a host can switch to the properties on block selection.

parameters.name: ActiveMobilePanelChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects another mobile tab.

parameters.name: MobileSheetSnapIndex
parameters.description: The snap of the mobile panels sheet (0 = half height, 1 = full). Two-way with MobileSheetSnapIndexChanged, so a host can collapse the sheet on an add-block action.

parameters.name: MobileSheetSnapIndexChanged
parameters.description: Raised when a gesture or the keyboard moves the mobile sheet to another snap.

parameters.name: CanvasTitle
parameters.description: The label of the canvas tab in the Tabs presentation. Null uses the localized default.

parameters.name: LeftRail
parameters.description: Content of the left panel's collapsed rail, below the expand button (an icon strip of the toolbox for a tablet).

parameters.name: RightRail
parameters.description: Content of the right panel's collapsed rail, below the expand button.

parameters.name: PersistWidthsKey
parameters.description: When set, panel widths the USER resized persist to (and restore from) localStorage under this key. Stored values are validated against the min/max widths; a width the host supplies explicitly after a user resize wins.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the shell renders. Auto measures the shell's own root; a forced value renders that mode without a DOM.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the rendered layout changes. The initial value is not a change.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Extra CSS classes for the shell root.
